categories.main_business_segments: The Group primarily operates in the manufacture and sale of instant noodles and beverages in China. It also has a bakery business and investment properties. The instant noodles and beverages segments constitute the major part of the Group's revenue and profit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced manufacturing technologies including aerospace temperature control technology for instant noodles, non-fried noodle production techniques, and digitalized production management systems. It integrates digital tools such as Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Energy Management System (EMS), and Warehouse Management System (WMS) to enhance production efficiency, quality control, and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves a broad consumer base in China, including wholesalers, direct retailers, and end consumers. It targets young consumers through innovative marketing and product development. The Group also collaborates with major retail chains such as Family Mart and supports sports events, indicating a focus on mass-market and lifestyle-oriented consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across mainland China with production bases and sales networks covering major regions including North, Northeast, Northwest, East, Central, South, and Southwest China. It also has offices in Hong Kong and engages in international collaborations but primarily focuses on the Chinese market.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing finished food and beverage products and distributing them through an extensive sales and logistics network. It maintains close relationships with upstream suppliers and manages supply chain risks actively.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include product innovation focusing on health, nutrition, and sustainability, digital transformation of operations, and strengthening brand and market presence. The Group invests in R&D centers for instant noodles and beverages, collaborates with universities and research institutions, and pursues sustainable development goals including carbon neutrality and green packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of instant noodles, beverages, and related food products. The Group also earns rental income from investment properties. Sales are recognized at the point of control transfer to customers, typically upon delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is a leading national brand in China's fast-moving consumer goods sector, particularly in instant noodles and beverages. It holds a strong market position supported by extensive distribution networks and strategic alliances, such as with PepsiCo. It competes with other major food and beverage companies in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group reported revenue of approximately RMB 80.65 billion in 2024, showing stable growth. Profit attributable to owners increased by 19.8% to RMB 3.73 billion. The Group maintains a robust financial structure with total assets over RMB 53 billion and continues to invest in digital transformation and sustainable development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes product quality, food safety, and innovation driven by advanced technologies including aerospace-grade standards. It offers a diversified product portfolio catering to health-conscious consumers and various consumption scenarios. Its strong brand recognition, extensive sales network, and commitment to sustainability and social responsibility differentiate it in the market.
